# Session

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

Live state for the current caller, including the selected conference, area, directory and user.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#board-and-session-400).

Use `Session` or `Session()` to obtain the current root object.

## AliasName

`Session.AliasName: STRING`

Read-only instance property.

A live, read-only value from the current caller's session.

## Area

## EditMessage

```PPL
Session.EditMessage(Msg original, [MSGHEADER header]) Msg
```

Instance function.

Edits and replaces the original stored message after access and conflict checks. Returns the saved MSG, or an invalid MSG on abort. Optional header defaults are passed by value; unknown JAM metadata survives. Errors update Error.Last() and support ON ERROR.

## PostMessage

```PPL
Session.PostMessage(Area area, [MSGHEADER header], [STRING initialText]) Msg
```

Instance function.

Runs normal message entry in the target area, including the editor and saving. Optional header and editable initial text supply defaults. Returns the saved MSG, or an invalid MSG on abort; errors update Error.Last().

## ReplyHeader

```PPL
Session.ReplyHeader(Msg original) MSGHEADER
```

Instance function.

Returns a local MSGHEADER with the normal reply defaults after access checks. Does not open the editor or save a message. Errors update Error.Last().

## ReplyMessage

```PPL
Session.ReplyMessage(Msg original, [MSGHEADER header], [STRING initialText]) Msg
```

Instance function.

Composes and saves a reply in the original message's area, with authorized quote text and reply linkage. Optional header and initial text are editable defaults. Returns the saved MSG, or an invalid MSG on abort; errors update Error.Last().

## RequestPasswordRecovery

```PPL
Session.RequestPasswordRecovery(STRING userName) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Requests password recovery for a login name or alias using only the account's saved email address. TRUE means the request was accepted, not that mail was sent; FALSE means recovery is globally disabled. Account exclusions, rate limits and delivery failures are logged, not exposed through Error.Last(). No caller permission or login-phase check, output, disconnect or user switch. Available in PPL 4.00.
